clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked into the eastern cliffs of Tanaris, the Caverns of Time serve as the mystical lair of Nozdormu and the bronze dragonflight. Within its winding depths, the dragons monitor and safeguard the fragile timeways of Azeroth against any mortal intrusion or temporal tampering.

Carved deep beneath the desert cliffs, the Caverns of Time are a nexus where the currents of history converge. Charged by the titans at the dawn of the world, Nozdormu the Timeless One and his bronze dragonflight act as eternal sentinels over these corridors. Inside, time behaves erratically; glimpses of past and future slip through hidden rifts, and relics plucked from distant eras lie scattered across the sands. While the great wyrm Anachronos keeps watch near the entrance, lesser bronze drakes patrol the winding descent, fiercely protective of the one true timeline.

Beyond being a junction of past and future, the caverns serve as an eccentric vault. Over millennia, the bronze flight has gathered historical fragments from every corner of Azeroth: ancient dwarven structures, a watchtower from Lordaeron, chieftain quarters from the orcish clans, and armor dating back to the first kings of Stromgarde. Yet despite the occasional traveler daring to slip past the sentinels to glimpse these wonders, the inner gateways remain tightly shut, awaiting the day the flight deems mortal intervention necessary.
